    How spoiler lock works

    Only facts known by your selected location.

    The app resolves the latest curated checkpoint at or before your chapter and position. Future entries never appear in the interface.

    Verified means the book states it directly. Inferred means continuity fills a gap. Needs review marks missing or ambiguous evidence.

    Unofficial fan project. No book text or artwork is distributed.
